Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

misocialr 0.4.0

  • Paging by cursorMark. Pages are read by the sort key (id), not by position: documents added or removed while reading no longer shift the pages. Checked live: the same 185 documents for PE in 2024-01 as paging by start. The checks for a stable total, no repeated id and nothing missing remain.
  • Nature of each field in the dictionary (nature, nature_basis in mds_fields()): estoque, fluxo, fluxo anual, acumulado, taxa, média or índice, with the rule for summing across municipalities and months in the help page. 18 fields were measured on the monthly series (PE, 2024-10 to 2025-12), 33 follow a measured field of the same group and 81 come from the label and unit.
  • Corrected label: the Fomento Rural field ..._ano_f equals the monthly one in 14,755 of 14,755 municipality-month pairs (Brazil, 2013–2026); it is the longest monthly series, not a yearly total.
  • options(misocialr.cache_ttl = seconds): optional cache validity (the default remains the session).
  • DESCRIPTION: cli (>= 3.6.1) and dplyr (>= 1.1.1) — the declared minimum versions were not usable together today: testthat 3.2.1 requires cli >= 3.6.1, and dplyr 1.1.0 calls the vctrs C routine vec_is_vector, removed in vctrs 0.7.0 (checked in the CI job that installs the minimum versions).

misocialr 0.3.1

Fixes from the final report on 0.3.0 and the parallel verification (details in REVISAO_FINAL_2026-10-19.md at the repository root).

  • Queries by POST. With many months, fields and codes, the GET URL exceeded the server limit (HTTP 414, reproduced with 35 fields, 288 months and 200 municipalities). The query now goes in the body; the same query returned 136,989 rows.
  • mds_drop_unpublished(action = "flag") keeps the three classification columns also on an empty table (F2); a datetime today is read as a date; the period follows the same calendar rule as documents and facets.
  • Non-finite values ("NaN", "Inf", "1e999") are a response error; in deduplication, a missing value never replaces a known one, in any order (F4).
  • Documents and facets with a month outside 01–12, facets with a repeated month, documents beyond numFound and incoherent facets (n_nonzero larger than n_localities, with a fresh read of the pair before the error) are errors and do not enter the cache (F5).
  • A body that is not JSON is a misocialr_error_response, with the original error in parent (F6).
  • Retry-After capped at 30 s per attempt and 120 s in total; options(misocialr.retry_backoff = ). Retries tested against a real local HTTP server (webfakes).
  • parse_periods(): years from 2000 to the year after the current one.
  • parse_localities(): states always character; round numeric codes without scientific notation in messages.
  • Behaviour cases shared with the Python package (tests/testthat/paridade/casos.json).
  • LICENSE.md with the full MIT text; data-raw/record_fixtures.R validates each recorded response and restores the previous fixtures if the replacement fails.
  • Suggests: jsonlite, webfakes.

misocialr 0.3.0

Fixes from the in-depth analysis of 0.2.1 (details in REVISAO_PROFUNDA_2026-10-19.md at the repository root).

  • Single response contract (check_response()): a partial result, a responseHeader$status other than 0, an invalid numFound and missing docs or facet_counts are errors, including in mds_periods(), mds_localities() and the field check. Only complete responses enter the cache (B1, B2, B8).
  • mds_localities() pages, checks codes and repetitions and gains period and refresh (B2).
  • mds_drop_unpublished() never removes a non-zero value: a contradictory national reference is queried again and, if still contradictory, the month is kept with a warning (B3). The period is normalised and checked as month 01 to 12, including factor and numeric (B6); field, today and infinite values are validated; a missing value is never treated as zero (B7). New action = "flag" (M2).
  • A document without a valid codigo_ibge or anomes_s is an error (B4); a non-scalar value is an error, without flattening lists (B5); two different values for the same key are a conflict error (B4). A requested municipality inside a requested state is not queried twice.
  • Paging: a numFound that changes between pages and a repeated id are errors (M5).
  • mds_periods() sums facets of disjoint blocks of up to 200 codes (M4) and gains refresh; canonical cache keys (M1).
  • Classed errors (misocialr_error_validation, _response, _conflict, _http), with status and parent on the HTTP error; retry on connection failure; version in the user agent; options(misocialr.quiet = TRUE) (M8).
  • storage_type in mds_fields() and mds_api_fields(); unit "unknown" for _s and fields without suffix (M3).
  • Local field validation even with validate = FALSE (M7); warning for a municipality without documents (M9); ibge_code7() computes each code once (M6).
  • DESCRIPTION: httr2 (>= 1.0.4), testthat (>= 3.2.1) (B9).
  • data-raw/record_fixtures.R records into a temporary folder and only replaces the fixtures after checking the result, keeping a copy in api.bak/ (B10).
  • CI workflows in .github/workflows/ (M10).

misocialr 0.2.1

Fixes from the external review of 0.2.0 (details in REVISAO_2026-10-19.md at the repository root).

  • An empty, NA or empty-string locality is an error; it used to become a query for the whole of Brazil.
  • Every locality is validated, even next to "BR".
  • A 7-digit code with a wrong check digit is an error; the last digit used to be dropped (2611600 queried Recife).
  • An empty, NA, non-integer or negative period mixed with others is an error.
  • A text field is an error (regiao); its values used to become NA and vanish. Identification fields (municipio, anomes_s…) cannot be requested as a measure.
  • An empty page before numFound, a partial Solr result and a response without response are errors; reading used to finish with missing data.
  • mds_api_fields() pages through the whole history (previously up to 1,000 documents) and returns an empty table, with a warning, for a municipality without documents.
  • mds_drop_unpublished() validates period and value and gains reference = "brazil", which decides by the whole country.
  • options(misocialr.timeout = ) and attr(x, "retrieved_at").
  • Shortcuts with fields = NULL, as in Python; mds_themes() help page with the seven shortcuts.
  • DESCRIPTION: dplyr (>= 1.1.0) and purrr (>= 1.0.0).
  • Errors from mds_data() reach the user without purrr’s “In index: 1” wrapper.

misocialr 0.2.0

  • Four new themes, with shortcuts: mds_suas_rede(), mds_suas_financiamento(), mds_pbf_condicionalidades() and mds_seguranca_alimentar(). The dictionary grows from 35 to 130 fields.
  • The Bolsa Família quilombola and homeless fields leave the dictionary: the API returns the same value in both fields in every municipality and month.
  • A field may belong to more than one theme (CRAS and CREAS).
  • Fields with the _l suffix (long integer) now have unit count.

misocialr 0.1.0

  • First version: mds_data(), shortcuts mds_cadunico(), mds_bolsa_familia() and mds_bpc_suas(); discovery with mds_themes(), mds_fields(), mds_api_fields(), mds_periods() and mds_localities(); mds_drop_unpublished(), ibge_code7() and mds_clear_cache().
